item.title: McDonald’s Removes AI Christmas Ad After Backlash in Netherlands
item.description: McDonald’s has removed a Christmas advertisement generated with artificial intelligence after receiving criticism online. item.description: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai says no company, including Google, would be immune if the artificial intelligence market were to suffer a valuation correction.
